name: copy_sixteen_longwords_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen consecutive 32-bit words from a fixed offset of a base structure into a caller-supplied buffer when that pointer is non-null. It then makes an indirect call through a stored code pointer.

name: scan_entries_fill_header_buffer
description: Walks a linked list of entries to find the largest value in a chosen field, then allocates a block and fills it with ascending tag words. It copies a sixteen-word template in and out of the block around indirect library calls.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen consecutive 32-bit words from a fixed offset of a base structure into a caller-supplied buffer when that pointer is non-null. It then makes an indirect call through a stored code pointer.

name: start_iconx_with_argument_vector
description: Program entry that creates an IconX process record, links it into a task list and opens the DOS library. It splits the command line into an argument vector, honouring quoted strings and escape characters, and restores the previous task pointer on exit.

name: release_iconx_task_resources
description: Swaps a new value into the current task's process record and returns the previous value. It releases each stored resource that is set, closing a file, a library base or a message reply, through the matching library calls.

name: open_iconx_console_window
description: Handles the IconX startup path by opening a console window from a CON: specification, with a fixed delay. It reports a not-enough-memory message when allocation fails and shows a notice that the program is for Workbench use on one path.

name: run_iconx_wait_or_endcli
description: Processes an icon request by building a command buffer and looking up a handler to dispatch it. When the result is a single dot-prefixed character, it runs extra handler calls, then executes either a long WAIT or an endcli command redirected to NIL:, depending on flags.

name: initialize_icon_library_functions
description: Creates a library from its first field and registers its function table through the exec library calls. It enables the functions when the table is present and returns the library result.

name: build_path_from_string_nodes
description: Joins the printable entries of a linked list of string nodes into a path, separated by delimiters. Unless the first entry is a control marker, it replaces the first slash in the result with a colon and frees its scratch buffer.

name: concatenate_strings_into_buffer
description: Copies one string into a destination and appends a second string to it. It then passes the position just past the joined text to a further routine, so the buffer ends up holding both strings in order.

name: count_string_length
description: Returns the number of bytes before the terminating zero of a string. It walks the string one byte at a time, incrementing a counter until it reaches the zero.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination, one at a time, including the terminating zero. It stops after writing the zero.

name: advance_to_string_terminator
description: Moves a pointer forward through a zero-terminated string until it reaches the terminator. It then passes that position and the second argument unchanged to another routine.

name: parse_signed_decimal_integer
description: Parses a decimal integer from a zero-terminated string, accepting an optional leading plus or minus sign. It accumulates the digits and negates the result when a minus sign was present.

name: forward_with_stack_frame_pointer
description: Passes its two arguments to another routine and adds a pointer into the caller's stack frame as a third argument. It contains no other work.

name: format_stack_message_and_output
description: Formats text into a 140-byte stack buffer through the exec formatting routine, then measures the result up to its zero terminator. If the text is non-empty, it passes the buffer and its length to another routine.

name: call_raw_do_fmt_vector
description: Calls the exec formatting entry through a library pointer held in global data. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: A tiny routine that writes the low byte of a data register to the memory address held in an address register, then returns.

name: validate_disk_bitmap_count
description: Program entry that walks a bitmap of 32-bit words, testing each bit against a stored pattern and counting the blocks that differ. It loops over block ranges, calling subroutines for each block, and sets a status value when a sentinel result is reached.

name: start_program_and_idle_loop
description: Program entry that stores pointers to global data and a handler routine, runs several setup calls, then loops forever calling two routines. It has no exit path.

name: initialize_paired_tables_wait
description: Fills two tables with repeated pairs of fixed 16-bit values, then runs a nested busy-wait delay loop. When a flag word is non-zero, it writes fixed entries and adds a value scaled from that flag into the table.

name: store_four_offset_longword_pairs
description: Reads a 32-bit value from a fixed offset in a structure and stores four copies of it in global storage, each split into low and high 16-bit words. The four copies are spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: combine_bitplane_mask_rows
description: Copies a block of 480 32-bit words, then clears a set of rows and rebuilds them. Each row combines three bitplane words with AND, OR and NOT operations and stores the results as split 16-bit words.

name: service_four_audio_channel_requests
description: Checks four request flags, one per audio channel. For each set flag whose channel is not busy, it marks the channel busy and updates that channel's volume and enable state.

name: start_audio_sample_free_channel
description: Starts a sound sample on a free audio channel by searching the channel table. It records the sample pointer and length and sets the channel's pointer registers, returning early when the requested state already matches or is idle.

name: load_samples_into_audio_channels
description: For each of four audio channel entries that is active and matches the current value, it copies the sample address, length and volume into that channel's hardware registers. It then enables the channel and marks the entry as consumed.

name: open_and_read_file_block
description: Opens a file through the DOS library, retrying until a handle is returned, then reads into the buffer and retries while the read reports an error. It closes the file and the library before returning its length argument.

name: close_file_and_return_value
description: Closes the DOS file handle, then closes the library base, and returns the value it was given unchanged.

name: write_output_file_with_cleanup
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and writes data to it. On success it closes the file and library, and on failure it runs a further DOS call before closing the same resources.

name: open_dos_library_base
description: Opens the DOS library through the exec old-open call and stores the returned base pointer in global data.

name: report_io_error_close_files
description: Fetches the DOS error code, closes the file and then the library base. It returns a failure result that carries the value it was given.

name: open_file_query_then_close
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and, if the handle is valid, makes a further DOS call on it and keeps the result in global data. On failure it closes the file and the library before returning.

name: decode_keyboard_scancode_to_char
description: Decodes a raw keyboard serial byte by inverting it and checking its key-up bit. It translates key codes through a lookup table of keymap characters, and for two special codes it updates a modifier flag.

name: reset_modifier_flag_for_keys
description: Clears a modifier flag when the masked key code is one of two special codes, then returns its argument unchanged.

name: install_graphics_interrupt_state
description: Opens the graphics library and saves one of its view fields. It then writes a fixed DMA and interrupt enable mask into the custom chip registers, and closes the library before returning.

name: disable_and_restore_custom_interrupts
description: Writes fixed clear masks to the DMA and interrupt control registers, restores two saved values, and then writes an enable mask. It operates only on the custom chip control and request registers.

name: handle_custom_interrupt_requests
description: Interrupt handler that checks the request register. One request bit sets a flag and acknowledges it, and another pushes a value into a 32-entry ring buffer and advances a counter. It also updates status bytes from two input state bits.

name: poll_mouse_and_button_state
description: Runs the same request path as the interrupt handler, then reads the fire and right and middle button registers. It stores the resulting position and button values in global data.

name: update_mouse_coordinates_within_bounds
description: Converts the change in a mouse counter into signed movement on two axes, adds it to the stored coordinates and clamps each to fixed screen limits. It also applies a minimum from a sprite structure to the vertical position.

name: update_mouse_coordinates_within_bounds
description: Converts the change in a mouse counter into signed movement on two axes, adds it to the stored coordinates and clamps each to fixed screen limits. It also applies a minimum from a sprite structure to the vertical position.

name: store_mouse_counters_clamp_position
description: Stores a new mouse counter value and adds a signed step to the horizontal position, with the sign chosen from a flag in the second register. It clamps both coordinates to fixed screen limits and applies the sprite minimum to the vertical position.

name: update_vertical_mouse_from_port
description: Computes the signed change in the mouse port's vertical counter and adds it to the stored vertical position. It clamps the result to fixed limits and saves the new counter value for the next comparison.

name: store_horizontal_position_with_clamp
description: Stores an incoming horizontal value and adds a signed step to it, with the sign chosen from a flag. The result is clamped to a fixed range and then raised to the minimum from a sprite structure.

name: clamp_position_to_screen_limits
description: Clamps a vertical coordinate between a sprite-derived minimum and a fixed upper limit. It also clamps a horizontal coordinate to a fixed maximum.

name: forbid_task_switching
description: Calls the exec Forbid routine to stop task switching, and returns its arguments unchanged.

name: swap_state_wait_for_interrupt
description: Disables one interrupt source, swaps two saved 32-bit values and sets a ready flag. It then busy-waits until that source's request bit is set, runs a subroutine, and re-enables the source.

name: wait_for_request_bit_enable
description: Busy-waits until the request bit for one interrupt source is set, then writes the enable mask that re-arms that source.

name: match_record_parse_numeric_fields
description: Compares a fixed-length input string against a stored record. On a full match it decodes the decimal digit fields at fixed positions into global variables, and on a mismatch it falls into a failure path that calls a reset routine.

name: match_record_store_numeric_fields
description: Compares a fixed-length input string against a stored record. On a full match it decodes the decimal digit fields at fixed positions into a different set of global variables, and on a mismatch it falls into a failure path that calls a reset routine.

name: match_record_parse_numeric_fields
description: Compares a fixed-length input string against a stored record. On a full match it decodes the decimal digit fields at fixed positions into global variables, and on a mismatch it falls into a failure path that calls a reset routine.

name: match_record_store_numeric_fields
description: Compares a fixed-length input string against a stored record. On a full match it decodes decimal fields and copies longword fields into global variables, and on a mismatch it falls into a failure path that calls a reset routine.

name: match_title_parse_fields
description: Compares input against a stored title text and, on a full match, decodes fixed decimal and longword fields into global variables. A mismatch falls into a failure path that calls a reset routine.

name: read_ring_buffer_or_reset
description: Takes the next entry from a 32-entry ring buffer when it differs from the write index. If the entry is one specific key code while a flag is clear, it resets the machine.

name: store_argument_in_context_slot
description: Stores its stack argument into a fixed 32-bit slot of a global context structure and returns nothing.

name: reset_machine
description: Executes the processor reset instruction and then jumps to the reset vector, restarting the machine. It has no return path in practice.

name: setup_blitter_copy_for_sprite
description: Waits for the blitter to finish, then programs its first and last word masks, modulo, source and destination pointers and blit size for a rectangular copy. The destination pointer is computed from the stored sprite position and frame data.

name: start_blitter_copy_stored_pointers
description: Waits for the blitter to finish, then programs its masks, control registers, pointers and blit size from values stored in the context structure, and starts the blit.

name: load_table_entry_accumulate_totals
description: Looks up an entry in a fixed table and scales two of its fields by 6000. It accumulates three count fields into a total using repeated additions, then copies the results and the remaining entry fields into a context structure.

name: lzss_decompress_into_buffer
description: Decompresses an LZSS-style stream into an output buffer. It first fills a 4096-byte window with spaces, then reads flag bytes that select between literal bytes and back-references, copying each into the output and the window until the requested length is reached.

name: advance_timed_sequence_object
description: Updates a sequence object by counting down several timers in its record. When a timer expires it runs the matching step, which repeats a subroutine call ten times, and it resets the step counter when the sequence ends.

name: format_three_digits_blank_padded
description: Writes a 16-bit number as three decimal digit characters into a buffer, splitting it into hundreds, tens and units. Leading zero digits are replaced by spaces.

name: render_sixteen_column_bitplane_tiles
description: Draws a grid of tiles into four bitplanes: for each of twenty rows and sixteen columns it reads a source byte, masks it through a lookup table and writes four bytes into planes spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: update_entry_highlight_flags
description: Scans two lists of entries and sets a highlight flag on each entry whose stored value matches the current selection, clearing it otherwise. It then copies the matched value into a status buffer.

name: advance_cyclic_selection_index
description: Advances a cyclic selection of fourteen positions by an offset taken from two counters. It updates the current index and loads the pointers and counter associated with the new position.

name: select_sequence_and_run_steps
description: Selects a sequence record from a table when the index is valid, then runs its steps. It waits on the frame counter before each step, calls the step routines, and repeats until the record's terminator is reached.

name: start_sequence_at_index
description: Stores a chosen sequence index, loads the first entry pointer and then runs the same frame-synced step loop until the entry is zero.

name: add_decimal_digit_text
description: Adds a constant numeric text to a stored string of decimal digits, from the least significant digit upward with carry. It writes the result back as digit characters.

name: subtract_constant_digits_in_place
description: Subtracts a fixed table of digit values from a seven-digit numeric text in place, borrowing between digits. It writes the results back as digit characters.

name: subtract_constant_digits_in_place
description: Subtracts a fixed table of digit values from a seven-digit numeric text in place, borrowing between digits. It writes the results back as digit characters.

name: run_frame_synced_sequence_steps
description: Loops over a sequence of entries, waiting on the frame counter before each step, until the next entry is zero.

name: draw_text_string_to_bitplanes
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into four bitplanes one character at a time, using an eight-row glyph table. Spaces blank their cell, and each glyph byte is masked through a lookup table before it is written.

name: advance_list_pointer_and_repeat
description: Advances a list pointer and, when it reaches a sentinel value, rewinds it to a saved position. It then calls a subroutine ten times.

name: run_seven_calls_three_times
description: Calls a subroutine seven times in each of three passes, with no other work.

name: fill_panel_rows_on_change
description: When a tracked state value differs from its previous value, it counts the change and calls a subroutine for the first few changes. After more changes it fills a block of rows in one bitplane with solid bytes, the block height depending on the stored value.

name: fill_plane_block_with_byte
description: Fills a rectangle of one bitplane with a constant byte, eight columns wide and seventy-two rows tall, or seven columns wide for one index. It uses a forty-byte row stride.

name: render_stats_screen_with_labels
description: Draws a statistics screen by copying a data block into the bitplanes and clearing a table. It writes the labels for beam in feet, displacement, length in feet, maximum speed and takeoff weight, waits on the raster position register, and re-enables multitasking at the end.

name: read_planes_to_interleaved_buffer
description: Copies eighty-four rows of four bitplane words, spaced 8000 bytes apart, into a contiguous buffer, interleaving the planes as it goes.

name: write_interleaved_buffer_to_planes
description: Copies a contiguous buffer back out to four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart. It is the reverse of the plane-to-buffer copy, writing eighty-four rows of seven words.

name: copy_screen_buffer_and_permit
description: Copies a stored 32-longword block and then copies four bitplanes to the display buffer, clearing the remainder. It re-enables multitasking through the exec library at the end.

name: setup_screen_buffers_and_state
description: Records a key code and a status word, normalising one specific key code. It then computes the bitplane and buffer addresses from the program's data area, copies and clears the plane buffers, and re-enables multitasking.

name: draw_text_string_to_bitplanes
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into four bitplanes one character at a time, using an eight-row glyph table. Spaces blank their cell, and each glyph byte is masked through a lookup table before it is written.

name: draw_masked_tile_block
description: Draws a block of tiles into four bitplanes, four tiles wide and eight rows deep. Each tile's pattern bits are combined with a mask through a lookup, with the mode taken from a stored state value.

name: build_sprite_mask_and_rows
description: Builds a sixteen-entry mask by rotating a word, sets a limit from the item's coordinates, and copies plane data for each sprite row into a buffer. It also writes an interrupt control value.

name: read_input_update_control_record
description: Reads the fire buttons and a stored input state, then updates a control record's coordinates and frame counter. It writes the resulting position into sprite control words, using a table of frame offsets selected by the frame index.

name: write_sprite_control_words
description: Computes a sprite's screen position from stored coordinates and writes its position and control words into two sprite buffers. It then runs subroutines and copies a frame index into the animation state.

name: set_sprite_frame_advance_counter
description: Looks up a frame value from a table by index and stores it in the record. When the index is eighteen it negates the record's velocity, then advances a counter that wraps at ten.

name: set_alt_sprite_frame_advance
description: Looks up a frame value from a second table by index and stores it in the record. When the index is eighteen it negates the record's velocity, then advances a counter that wraps at ten.

name: check_overlap_advance_sprite_frames
description: Scans a list of sprite records and skips any that lie outside a rectangle around a given point. For each record inside it, the routine updates hit counters and picks an animation frame from one of three tables by direction, then advances a counter that wraps at ten.

name: load_sprite_frame_longwords
description: Copies an eight-byte frame entry from a table into a record as two longwords, then calls a subroutine.

name: shift_and_merge_plane_rows
description: Shifts four source bitplane words right by a bit count and merges them into the destination planes through a mask. It clears the masked area first and repeats for sixteen rows.

name: copy_block_and_loop_forever
description: Program entry that copies six longwords from a source block into a fixed area, then stores pointers to global data and a handler. It runs setup calls and then loops forever calling subroutines, with no exit path.

name: initialize_paired_tables_wait
description: Fills two tables with repeated pairs of fixed 16-bit values, then runs a nested busy-wait delay loop. When a flag word is non-zero, it writes fixed entries and adds a value scaled from that flag into the table.

name: copy_indexed_table_row
description: Copies twelve 16-bit values from a row of a table, selected by a stored index, into a strided global buffer.

name: store_four_offset_longword_pairs
description: Reads a 32-bit value from a fixed offset in a structure and stores four copies of it in global storage, each split into low and high 16-bit words. The four copies are spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: combine_bitplane_mask_rows

description: Decompresses an LZSS-style stream into an output buffer. It first fills a 4096-byte window with spaces, then reads flag bytes that select between literal bytes and back-references, copying each into the output and the window until the requested length is reached.

name: copy_packed_image_into_planes
description: Stores values for each entry of a pointer table, then copies a 4000-word block from a source into four bitplanes spaced 8000 bytes apart. Subroutines handle the table steps and the surrounding work.

name: empty_routine_returns_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns straight away.

name: run_record_draw_loop
description: Sets up a drawing record from a block of fields and chooses a buffer size of 32000 or 64000 bytes from a flag. It then loops over the record's entries, calling subroutines, until a termination flag is set.

name: merge_source_bits_into_column
description: Walks a column of source bytes, looks up a mask for each one and merges the result with the existing values in four bitplanes. It writes back with a 40-byte row stride.

name: merge_source_bits_into_column
description: Walks a column of source bytes, looks up a mask for each one and merges the result with the existing values in four bitplanes. It writes back with a 40-byte row stride.

name: update_timing_totals_for_mode
description: Updates timing totals from two counters, scaling them by 6000 or 3000 depending on the mode. For the default mode it stores fixed limits instead, and it sets the per-step increment for the next step.

name: run_frame_synced_status_loop
description: Runs a frame-synchronised loop that toggles status words and calls subroutines, advancing in steps of three frames. It stops when the step value is non-zero or the counter reaches its threshold, then restores a saved longword.

name: run_status_update_if_done
description: Returns at once if a countdown field has not reached three. Otherwise it runs a set of subroutine calls, sets a status word, and clears the countdown.

name: run_status_update_sequence
description: Calls a fixed sequence of subroutines, sets a status word from a stored value, toggles a flag and clears a countdown field.

name: check_record_bounds_and_mark
description: Compares a record's position against the current coordinates and a size window. When the record lies inside the window, it stores a scaled grid position and sets a visibility flag.

name: run_main_update_state_machine
description: Runs the frame's main state machine. It compares several stored state words, calls subroutines to step the on-screen records, and repeats until the state settles.

name: copy_record_fields_and_wrap
description: Copies position, size and flag fields from one record into another and clears the destination's active flag. It then wraps the two coordinates by a modulus of 375 relative to a supplied offset.

name: wrap_record_coordinates_modulo_375
description: Wraps the two stored coordinates of a record by a modulus of 375, adjusting each by a supplied offset.

name: blank_character_cell_block
description: Blanks a block of character cells by writing the space character at several offsets from a base pointer, stepping across rows.

name: build_status_text_line
description: Builds a status text line in a text buffer by blanking the cell area and copying a label string, followed by a colon and a second string. The line is written only for records whose index is in range.

name: store_index_pair_for_record
description: Stores its argument into a record field. If the value is negative it also stores it in a second field and returns, otherwise it stores a second value obtained from a subroutine.

name: scan_entries_until_row_match
description: Initialises a scan record and repeatedly calls a subroutine to read the next entry. It stops when the entry's row matches the current row or a sentinel is reached, and treats one entry type with a second comparison.

name: swap_record_index_pair
description: Stores a new index and, when it is non-negative, swaps it with the previously stored index. When the two are equal it marks the stored slot as empty.

name: scan_entries_until_row_match
description: Initialises a scan record and repeatedly calls a subroutine to read the next entry. It stops when the entry's row matches the current row or a sentinel is reached, and treats one entry type with a second comparison.

name: repeat_calls_with_masked_counter
description: Repeats a loop for a given count, calling subroutines on each pass and advancing a masked counter by one each time.

name: call_subroutine_and_return
description: Calls a single subroutine and returns.

name: store_byte_in_indexed_slot
description: Writes a byte into a field of a table entry. The entry is located by looking up a 16-bit index in a table, and a subroutine is called afterwards.

name: build_labeled_value_text_line
description: Blanks a text area, then copies a label, a colon and a second text string into it. It finishes the line with a short unit label.

name: format_three_digits_blank_padded
description: Writes a 16-bit number as three decimal digit characters into a buffer, splitting it into hundreds, tens and units. Leading zero digits are replaced by spaces.

name: format_three_digits_zero_padded
description: Writes a 16-bit number as three decimal digit characters by adding each digit to a template of zero characters. Leading zeros are kept as zero characters.

name: format_two_digits_zero_padded
description: Writes a 16-bit number as two decimal digit characters by adding each digit to a template of zero characters.

name: format_four_digits_blank_padded
description: Writes a 16-bit number as four decimal digit characters into a buffer, splitting it into thousands, hundreds, tens and units. Leading zero digits are replaced by spaces.

name: copy_planes_clear_text_rows
description: Copies a four-plane image into the screen buffers and clears a block of text rows. It then draws its label and value text through subroutines.

name: build_bit_spread_lookup_tables
description: Builds two lookup tables: the first holds bit-spread patterns for byte values, and the second holds Gray-code bit patterns for 512 values. It then blanks a text area with space characters.

name: blank_text_rows_with_spaces
description: Writes space characters across a block of text rows, with the number of rows chosen from a stored flag.

name: blank_text_rows_with_spaces
description: Writes space characters across a block of text rows, with the number of rows chosen from a stored flag.

name: copy_text_entries_into_rows
description: Copies a list of text entries into a text buffer, writing each character and its attribute byte. The attribute is stored 256 bytes after the character, and the list ends at a negative marker.

name: render_text_cells_four_passes
description: Renders a block of text cells across four passes, combining glyph bit patterns from lookup tables into the bitplanes and clearing cells as it goes. It calls subroutines to finish each pass.

name: update_timing_totals_for_mode
description: Updates timing totals from two counters, scaling them by 6000 or 3000 depending on the mode. For the default mode it stores fixed limits instead, and it sets the per-step increment for the next step. It also points two buffers at fixed offsets.

name: draw_text_string_to_bitplanes
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into four bitplanes one character at a time, using an eight-row glyph table. Spaces blank their cell, and each glyph byte is masked through a lookup table before it is written.

name: wait_for_frame_count
description: Busy-waits until the frame counter has advanced by the requested number of frames.

name: draw_status_string_with_update
description: Copies a pending value into a display slot when a flag is set, then draws a text string into the bitplanes glyph by glyph using a stored mask. Subroutines handle the surrounding updates.

name: initialize_display_planes_from_table
description: Copies a 32-longword header and an image of about 1840 longwords into the bitplanes, spaced 8000 bytes apart. It then clears a block of longwords in the first three planes and fills the fourth with ones.

name: draw_text_string_to_bitplanes
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into four bitplanes one character at a time, using an eight-row glyph table. Spaces blank their cell, and each glyph byte is masked through a lookup table before it is written.

name: run_frame_update_for_display
description: Per-frame update that records the frame counter, syncs state fields with their pending values and calls twenty-two subroutines to refresh the displayed items.

name: draw_current_item_entry
description: Checks a per-item flag and, depending on whether the current position matches the stored one, selects and draws an entry. It writes a blank label when there is no match, then calls subroutines to place the item graphics.

name: composite_masked_plane_block
description: Composites a block of 10 by 7 words from source planes into the destination. Source bits are ORed in wherever the mask plane is clear.

name: draw_text_string_masked
description: Draws a zero-terminated string into four bitplanes glyph by glyph, combining each glyph byte with the existing plane bytes through a mask. Spaces are drawn as blank cells.

name: draw_shifted_item_graphic
description: Computes a screen address from the item's position and draws its graphic into the bitplanes. The bit pattern is shifted by the low bits of the position and merged with the existing bytes through a mask, and an angle value is wrapped modulo 360.

name: update_draw_visible_object_list
description: Updates the list of visible objects by moving a stored value halfway toward its target each time. It then walks the object records and draws each one through six subroutine calls.

name: draw_object_records_loop
description: Walks a list of object records, drawing each one through a subroutine call with its position and frame fields. After each draw it refreshes the record's index entry and advances, stopping at a negative link.

name: clip_rectangle_to_screen_marks
description: Tests whether a rectangle lies inside the screen bounds and returns a failure value when it is fully outside. When it is partly outside, it marks the edge words of the clip table and returns its input.

name: traverse_and_draw_object_records
description: Walks a linked chain of object records, dividing a total by twenty-two to set a count, and draws each record through subroutine calls. It updates the links between records as it goes.

name: blend_two_values_by_fraction
description: Splits a stored value between two fields using a fraction derived from a byte. The second field receives the scaled part and the first receives the remainder.

name: project_object_into_draw_record
description: Projects an object's size and position into a draw record. It looks up size and offset values from a table by the object's frame, scales them by a divisor, and stores the results with the position fields.

name: project_object_to_record_alt
description: Projects an object's size and position into a draw record, using a different scale choice for two special frame types. Table values supply the size and offset, and the resulting position fields are stored in the record.

name: project_flagged_object_to_record
description: Projects an object whose flag bit is set into a draw record. It scales the size from a table by a divisor, stores the position from the object's coordinates and an offset table, and adjusts a vertical position that overlaps a neighbour.

name: draw_object_list_with_clips
description: Walks the list of object records and draws each one that passes a clip test, calling subroutines for the clip and draw steps. It updates each record's index entry as it goes.

name: clip_rectangle_wide_bounds
description: Tests whether a rectangle lies inside a set of bounds and returns a failure value when it is fully outside. Otherwise it marks the edge words of the clip table, using the wider horizontal bound of 320.
